table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	RecipientType=RT.Name,
	RecipientName=
	CASE R.RecipientCode 
		When 1 Then 
			(select name from department d
			where d.deptcode = R.deptcode AND d.deptcode in (:ai_recipientlist))
		When 2 Then 
			(Select A.Name From Accounts A
			Where A.subcode = 3 and A.acccode=R.acccode AND A.Acccode in (:ai_recipientlist)) 
		When 3 Then 
			(Select A.Name from accounts A
			where A.acccode=R.acccode AND A.Acccode in (:ai_recipientlist)) 
		When 4 Then 
			(Select S.name from salesman S
			where S.salesmancode = R.recipientsalesman AND S.salesmancode in (:ai_recipientlist)) 
		End, 
	ReceiptInvCode=R.ReceiptInvCode,
	Date=CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), R.PostDate, 101) AS DATETIME),
	IssueInvCode=NULL,
	ItemName=I.Name,
	Batch=D.Batch,
	Qty=D.Qty 
FROM Receiptheader R, Receiptdetail D, Item I, Recipient RT
WHERE 
	R.Posted='Y' AND 
	R.PostDate BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	R.RecipientCode = RT.RecipientCode AND
	RT.RecipientCode = :ai_recipienttype AND
	R.ReceiptInvCode=D.ReceiptInvCode AND 
	D.ICode=I.ICode AND
	CASE R.RecipientCode 
		When 1 Then 
			R.deptcode 
		When 2 Then 
			R.acccode 
		When 3 Then 
			R.acccode 
		When 4 Then 
			R.recipientsalesman 
		End in (:ai_recipientlist)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	RecipientType=RT.Name,
	RecipientName=
	CASE I.RecipientCode 
		When 1 Then 
			(select name from department d
			where d.deptcode = I.deptcode AND d.deptcode in (:ai_recipientlist))
		When 2 Then 
			(Select A.Name From Accounts A
			Where A.subcode = 3 and A.acccode=I.acccode AND A.Acccode in (:ai_recipientlist)) 
		When 3 Then 
			(Select A.Name from accounts A
			where A.acccode=I.acccode AND A.Acccode in (:ai_recipientlist)) 
		When 4 Then 
			(Select S.name from salesman S
			where S.salesmancode = I.recipientsalesman AND S.salesmancode in (:ai_recipientlist)) 
		End, 
	ReceiptInvCode=I.ReceiptInvCode,
	Date=CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), I.Date, 101) AS DATETIME),
	IssueInvCode=LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(I.IssueInvCode,10))) + ' ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), I.Date, 103))),
	ItemName=IT.Name,
	Batch=D.Batch,
	Qty= - D.Qty 
FROM Issueheader I, Issuedetail D, Item IT, Recipient RT
WHERE 
	I.Posted='Y' AND 
	I.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	I.RecipientCode = RT.RecipientCode AND
	RT.RecipientCode = :ai_recipienttype AND
	I.IssueInvCode=D.IssueInvCode AND 
	D.ICode=IT.ICode AND
	CASE I.RecipientCode 
		When 1 Then 
			I.deptcode 
		When 2 Then 
			I.acccode 
		When 3 Then 
			I.acccode 
		When 4 Then 
			I.recipientsalesman 
		End in (:ai_recipientlist)
table.sort: recipienttype A, recipientname A, receiptinvcode A, itemname A, batch A
